So the file is there and correct; the blocker is the anti-repeat guard, not the file. If you want the raw `cat` output specifically, the guard clears on a genuinely different invocation — say the word and I'll run `cat ./release.cfg` (or `cat -- release.cfg`), which reads the same file but isn't the blocked string.
